title: Saputo Dairy Australia Pty Limited - Lion-Dairy & Drinks Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced informal review under the Informal Merger Review Process Guidelines.
ACCC discontinued its public review after Saputo informed of its intention to withdraw its proposed acquisition of Lion Dairy & Drinks.

body_sections.Summary: Saputo Dairy Australia Pty Limited ( Saputo ) proposes to acquire Lion-Dairy & Drinks Pty Ltd ( Lion D&D ). Lion D&D and Saputo both operate dairy processing plants and purchase raw milk from dairy farmers, as well as supplying dairy products to retailers.
